vectors.intent_statement: Make every agent action deterministic, dispatch-scoped, public-safe, and fail-closed.
Bound Quill to the minimum public Writers Guild capabilities and subjects required by the SRS.
Make every external dependency, runtime prerequisite, health check, and fallback explicit.
Persist substantive file, relationship, and verification provenance for the living-world dispatch.
Govern the JSON payload that records the living-world dispatch provenance and outcomes.
Define auditable level thresholds that structures reach only from real guild outcomes.
Authorize the Writers living-world work under the queued dispatch supplied by the operator.
Document only the runtime values used by the public service and mobile telemetry adapters.
Keep generated dependencies, builds, and coverage evidence out of source control.
Lock the audited Node dependency graph used to build and verify the Writers service.
Govern the reproducible dependency graph used to validate and run the public service.
Declare the public service runtime, integrations, telemetry, SBOM, build, and test toolchain.
Catalog exact dependency versions, licenses, relationships, and known vulnerabilities in CycloneDX format.
Attach governance provenance to the generated CycloneDX dependency and vulnerability inventory.
Register Quill's public Writers Guild service with stable ownership and telemetry tags.
Publish real Writers floor transitions while keeping NATS failures non-fatal.
Start the public Writers floor service with fail-soft NATS and Datadog integrations.
Merge sanitized source snapshots into one deterministic floor state with circuit breaking.
Send sanitized guild notifications and segments without transmitting raw member identifiers.
Convert read-only private GitLab metadata into opaque quest and aggregate activity signals.
Publish and consume public-safe inter-guild handoffs with versioned message schemas.
Fan out floor side effects without allowing any integration failure to block core state.
Track aggregate floor engagement and provide fail-soft feature-flag circuit breakers.
Limit every private-source adapter to the aggregate signals accepted by public floor state.
Turn aggregate lore and RPG-session counts into floor signals without reading row payloads.
Define one public-safe schema for the Writers floor feeds and required NATS events.
Derive structure growth only from verified lore, quest, and champion-uptime metrics.
Preserve only validated public floor state and default missing sources to a quiet floor.
Report healthy or quiet service mode without exposing connection details.
Accept only timestamped HMAC-authenticated workflow events and sanitize them into floor actions.
Bind Quill as the public Writers floor guildmaster avatar.
Expose the cleansed Writers floor snapshot consumed by the public game.
Serve only the public GET contracts required by the Writers living-world floor.
Trace floor operations and report source-derived Writers metrics without blocking service work.
Configure mobile app vitals from runtime values while disabling RUM when identifiers are absent.
Verify aggregate analytics, feature flags, messaging, and pseudonymous segmentation.
Prove floor state and events reflect validated inputs and remain quiet on unavailable sources.
Prove structures advance only when every documented real-metric threshold is met.
Verify the public realm and Quill party contracts over their exact HTTP paths.
Verify private-source bridges emit only aggregate, opaque, fail-soft floor signals.
Verify telemetry is environment-gated and never blocks living-world behavior.
Prove n8n requires fresh HMAC signatures and cross-guild messages match public schemas.
Enable strict deterministic TypeScript builds for the public living-world service.
Govern the JSON TypeScript configuration that validates the public living-world service.
Enforce repeatable living-world tests and minimum coverage for new public contracts.
